common.CloudMetadata.description: CloudMetadata is the metadata for a cloud provider managed asset (e.g., as part of AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI)

image.description: The name of the image the cloud managed host or container is based on.

vmImageID.description: VMImageID holds the VM instance's image ID.

common.CloudProvider.description: CloudProvider specifies the cloud provider name

common.Color.description: Color is a hexadecimal representation of color code value

common.ExternalLabel.description: ExternalLabel holds an external label with a source and timestamp

sourceName.description: Source name (e.g., for a namespace, the source name can be 'twistlock').

timestamp.description: Time when the label was fetched.

common.ExternalLabelSourceType.description: ExternalLabelSourceType indicates the source of the labels

shared.ContainerInfo.description: ContainerInfo contains all information gathered on a specific container

app.description: App is the app that is hosted in the container.

cluster.description: Cluster is the provided cluster name.

complianceIssues.description: ComplianceIssues are all the container compliance issues.

complianceRiskScore.description: ComplianceRiskScore is the container's compliance risk score.

externalLabels.description: ExternalLabels is the external labels e.g., kubernetes namespace labels.

image.description: Image is the canonical image name.

imageName.description: The image name as stated in the docker run command.

infra.description: Infra represents any container that belongs to the infrastructure.

namespace.description: Namespace is the k8s deployment namespace.

processes.description: Processes are the processes that are running inside the container.

profileID.description: ProfileID is the container profile id.

startTime.description: StartTime is the starting time of the container.

shared.ContainerNetwork.description: ContainerNetwork contains details about the container network (ports, IPs, type etc...)

ports.description: Ports are the ports details associated with the container.

shared.ContainerPort.description: ContainerPort represents the state of a port in a given container

container.description: Container is the mapped port inside the container.

host.description: Host is the host port number.

listening.description: Listening indicates whether the port is in listening mode.

nat.description: NAT indicates the port is exposed using NAT.

shared.ContainerProcess.description: ContainerProcess represents a process inside a container

shared.ContainerScanResult.description: ContainerScanResult contains the result of a scanning a container

agentless.description: Agentless indicates if the result was received by an agentless scanner.

agentlessScanID.description: AgentlessScanID is the ID of the agentless scan in which the result was received.

ais.description: AIS indicates the scan was performed by AIS.

collections.description: Collections are collections to which this container applies.

csa.description: CSA indicates the scan was performed by the CSA.

hostname.description: Hostname is the hostname on which the container is deployed.

runtimeEnabled.description: RuntimeEnabled indicates if any runtime rule applies to the container.

scanTime.description: ScanTime is the container scan time.

shared.DockerNetworkInfo.description: DockerNetworkInfo contains network-related information about a container

networks.description: Networks are the networks the container is connected to.

ports.description: Ports are the container network binding that are externally mapped.

shared.InstalledProducts.description:
InstalledProducts contains data regarding products running in environment
TODO #34713: Swarm support was deprecated in Joule, remove swarm node/manager boolean (and related compliance) in Lagrange

agentless.description: Agentless indicates whether the scan was performed with agentless approach.

apache.description: Apache indicates the apache server version, empty in case apache not running.

awsCloud.description: AWSCloud indicates whether AWS cloud is used.

crio.description: CRI indicates whether the container runtime is CRI (and not docker).

docker.description: Docker represents the docker daemon version.

dockerEnterprise.description: DockerEnterprise indicates whether the enterprise version of Docker is installed.

hasPackageManager.description: HasPackageManager indicates whether package manager is installed on the OS.

k8sApiServer.description: K8sAPIServer indicates whether a kubernetes API server is running.

k8sControllerManager.description: K8sControllerManager indicates whether a kubernetes controller manager is running.

k8sEtcd.description: K8sEtcd indicates whether etcd is running.

k8sFederationApiServer.description: K8sFederationAPIServer indicates whether a federation API server is running.

k8sFederationControllerManager.description: K8sFederationControllerManager indicates whether a federation controller manager is running.

k8sKubelet.description: K8sKubelet indicates whether kubelet is running.

k8sProxy.description: K8sProxy indicates whether a kubernetes proxy is running.

k8sScheduler.description: K8sScheduler indicates whether the kubernetes scheduler is running.

managedClusterVersion.description: ManagedClusterVersion is the version of the managed Kubernetes service, e.g. AKS/EKS/GKE/etc.

openshift.description: Openshift indicates whether openshift is deployed.

openshiftVersion.description: OpenshiftVersion represents the running openshift version.

serverless.description: Serverless indicates whether evaluated on a serverless environment.

swarmManager.description: SwarmManager indicates whether a swarm manager is running.

swarmNode.description: SwarmNode indicates whether the node is part of an active swarm.

shared.NetworkInfo.description: NetworkInfo contains data about a container regarding a specific network

containerPort.description: ContainerPort is the mapped port inside the container.

vuln.AllCompliance.description: AllCompliance contains data regarding passed compliance checks

compliance.description: Compliance are all the passed compliance checks.

enabled.description: Enabled indicates whether passed compliance checks is enabled by policy.

vuln.Distribution.description: Distribution counts the number of vulnerabilities per type

vuln.Secret.description: Secret represents a secret found on the scanned workload

group.description: Group is a group name or ID of owner the file metadata containing the secret.

locationInFile.description: LocationInFile is the line and offset in the file where the secret was found.

metadataModifiedTime.description: MetadataModifiedTime is the modification time of the file metadata containing the secret.

modifiedTime.description: ModifiedTime is the modification time of the file containing the secret.

path.description: Path is the path of the file in which the secret was found.

permissions.description: Permissions are permission bits of the file metadata containing the secret.

secretID.description: SecretID is the SHA1 of the secret content.

size.description: Size is the size in bytes of the file in which the secret was found.

snippet.description: Snippet is the partial plain secret.

user.description: User is a username or ID of owner the file metadata containing the secret.

vuln.TagInfo.description: TagInfo is the tag info in a specific vulnerability context

comment.description: Tag comment in a specific vulnerability context.

vuln.Vulnerability.description: Vulnerability is a general schema for vulnerabilities (e.g., for compliance or packages)

binaryPkgs.description: Names of the distro binary package names (packages which are built from the source of the package).

block.description: Indicates if the vulnerability has a block effect (true) or not (false).

cause.description: Additional information regarding the root cause for the vulnerability.

cri.description: Indicates if this is a CRI-specific vulnerability (true) or not (false).

custom.description: Indicates if the vulnerability is a custom vulnerability (e.g., openscap, sandbox) (true) or not (false).

cve.description: CVE ID of the vulnerability (if applied).

discovered.description: Specifies the time of discovery for the vulnerability.

fixDate.description: Date/time when the vulnerability was fixed (in Unix time).

fixLink.description: Link to the vendor's fixed-version information.

functionLayer.description: Specifies the serverless layer ID in which the vulnerability was discovered.

gracePeriodDays.description: Number of grace days left for a vulnerability, based on the configured grace period. Nil if no block vulnerability rule applies.

isRPMModule.description: IsRPMModule indicates whether this vulnerability is specific to an RPM module.

layerTime.description: Date/time of the image layer to which the CVE belongs.

packageName.description: Name of the package that caused the vulnerability.

packageVersion.description: Version of the package that caused the vulnerability (or null).

published.description: Date/time when the vulnerability was published (in Unix time).

rpmModule.description: RPMModule specifies the RPM module containing the package affected by this vulnerability.

severity.description: Textual representation of the vulnerability's severity.

templates.description: List of templates with which the vulnerability is associated.

twistlock.description: Indicates if this is a Twistlock-specific vulnerability (true) or not (false).

vecStr.description: Textual representation of the metric values used to score the vulnerability.

vuln.WildFireMalware.description: WildFireMalware holds the data for WildFire malicious MD5

md5.description: MD5 is the hash of the malicious binary.

path.description: Path is the path to malicious binary.

verdict.description: Verdict is the malicious source like grayware, malware and phishing.

vulnerability.ExploitData.description: ExploitData holds information about an exploit

link.description: Link is a link to information about the exploit.

vulnerability.ExploitKind.description: ExploitKind represents the kind of the exploit

vulnerability.ExploitType.description: ExploitType represents the source of an exploit

vulnerability.Exploits.description: Exploits represents the exploits data found for a CVE

vulnerability.RiskFactors.description: RiskFactors maps the existence of vulnerability risk factors

waas.OutOfBandMode.description: OutOfBandMode holds the app firewall out-of-band mode

waas.ProtectionStatus.description: ProtectionStatus describes the status of the WAAS protection

enabled.description: Enabled indicates if WAAS proxy protection is enabled (true) or not (false).

ports.description: Ports indicates http open ports associated with the container.

supported.description: Supported indicates if WAAS protection is supported (true) or not (false).

tlsPorts.description: TLSPorts indicates https open ports associated with the container.

unprotectedProcesses.description: UnprotectedProcesses holds the processes that support HTTP/HTTPS without WAAS protection.

waas.UnprotectedProcess.description: UnprotectedProcess holds unprotected processes alongside the port

tls.description: TLS is the port TLS indication.
